final: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(si.healtheval, '(missing)') AS health_status, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY COALESCE(si.healtheval, '(missing)')), shares AS (SELECT health_status, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts), above_average AS (SELECT record_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS average_excess_share FROM above_average
